description: After BUG-488 MiniQMT pre-trade uses broker quote (quote_source=MINIQMT_REALTIME.broker_quote, confirmed live), L2/L16 still PRE_RUN_FAILED with REALTIME_QUOTE_LIMIT_RANGE_INVALID: limit_up==limit_down==int(pre_close), < pre_close (000048.SZ 20.75->20.0/20.0; 603303.SH 30.14->30.0/30.0); broker_called=false, no orders/fills, observed_count~481. normalize_miniqmt_quote_row (minqmtsim.py:1118) does NOT emit limit_up/limit_down -> the degenerate values come from downstream market_data limit handling on the broker-quote path (either reads a degenerate broker raw limit field, or the derived-limit path mis-computes for the broker source). FIX: MiniQMT broker-quote pre-trade limits must be valid A-share limits -- derive from pre_close x board%/ST(5%) with correct per-board tick rounding (reuse the existing _derived_realtime_limit_price_from_previous_close / _a_share_daily_limit_pct path, incl. BUG-466 ST 5%), OR authoritative stk_limit; reject/ignore degenerate broker limit fields (limit_up==limit_down or not matching pre_close+/-pct); if limits genuinely unavailable -> loud fail with ACCURATE source label (no hardcoded 'TDX'). Also fix the misleading message at market_data.py:617 (_quote_source_label) / :1754 so it reports MINIQMT not TDX. L2/L16 then pass pre-run when limits valid. Add regression: broker-quote with degenerate/absent limit fields -> derives valid limits (pass) OR loud-fails with correct source label; no 'TDX' text on MINIQMT path. MiniQMT-scoped; do not change LocalSim TDX limit logic.
